meta.homeDescription: The official Musaffo branch in Khorezm. Product catalog: drinking and thick yogurts, glazed curd snacks, milk, butter, qatiq, kefir and ayran.
meta.catalogDescription: All Musaffo products: filter by category, fat content and brand.
meta.categoryDescription: Musaffo: {category}. Products, fat content, sizes and storage conditions.
meta.aboutDescription: Musaffo Khorezm is the official branch and distributor of Musaffo products (MCHJ QK «Milk House») in the Khorezm region. The brand’s history goes back to 1974.

home.fridgeHint: Tap a product, see the details and add it to your order list by the box.
home.intro: Musaffo is a dairy brand by MCHJ QK «Milk House».
home.step1Text: From the fridge, the catalog or plain text: pick the products and the number of boxes.
home.step2Text: Leave your name, phone and address. No sign-up needed.
home.step3Text: Our manager contacts you to confirm the order.
home.waysHint: For shops and agents: pick whichever suits you.
home.labelsText: Musaffo-styled price labels for your shelf: type your price and print on A4.

trust.title: Why Musaffo
trust.rawText: Our products are made from natural raw materials.
trust.qualityText: Product quality goes through multi-stage control.
trust.productionText: Our products are made with modern production methods.

about.branchTitle: The official Musaffo branch in Khorezm
about.branchText: Musaffo Khorezm is the official branch and distributor, in the Khorezm region, of Musaffo products made by MCHJ QK «Milk House».
about.title: Musaffo: a dairy brand from Tashkent
about.intro: Musaffo is a dairy brand by MCHJ QK «Milk House», Tashkent.
about.statMilkBottom: of raw milk processed per day
about.event1974: Started as the First Tashkent Dairy Combine, supplying Tashkent and the region with milk, cream and other dairy products.
about.event1995: Expanded production capacity and strengthened its position on Uzbekistan’s dairy market.
about.event2016: The Musaffo brand was launched, combining traditional quality with modern production.
about.event2025: The product range was expanded and packaging rebranded while keeping the brand recognizable.

catalog.title: Product catalog
catalog.emptyHint: Add products by the box: the total is calculated automatically, then place your order or print the list.

app.title: The catalog, always on your phone
app.point1: In a warehouse or with poor signal, products, box quantities and storage conditions still open
app.point2: Opens from your phone’s home screen with one tap, like an app
app.point3: Build your order list offline and send it when you’re back online
app.failed: Not everything was saved. What was saved stays in place, so continue when the signal improves.
app.iosHint: To install on iPhone: in Safari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
app.offlineStrip: No internet: showing the saved catalog

list.title: Order list
list.note: Your list is stored on this device. When you tap Place order, it’s sent to our manager, who will contact you to confirm the order.
list.emptyHint: Add products by the box: the total is calculated automatically, and you can send the list via Telegram or print it.
list.sharedNote: This list was opened from a link. To change or order it, add it to your own list.

search.hint: Type in Latin or Cyrillic letters; typos are fine. For example: qatiq, кефир, kefir 900.
search.emptyHint: Try another spelling, or browse the catalog.

quick.title: Quick order
quick.hint: All products in one list: enter the number of boxes and the total adds up by itself.
quick.bannerText: Ordering many products? See them all in one list.

labels.title: Price labels
labels.hint: Type your shop's prices and print Musaffo-styled shelf labels. Leave a price empty and the label keeps a space to write it by hand.
labels.metaDescription: Shelf price labels for Musaffo products: type your price and print on A4.
labels.searchPlaceholder: Add a product: kefir, qatiq, sirok…
labels.emptyHint: Add products with the buttons above or the search.
labels.saved: Prices are kept on this device, so next time there's nothing to retype.
labels.entryHint: Print shelf price labels for these products
labels.qr: A QR code on every label
labels.qrHint: When a product runs low, scan the code on its label with your phone camera: one box goes on your order list.

usual.title: Your usual order
usual.hint: Change a quantity, or set what you don't need to 0.
usual.other: Everything else is in the catalog

receipt.title: Order slip
receipt.next: The manager will contact you to confirm the order.
receipt.saveHint: Send it on Telegram or keep it in your gallery.

orders.title: My orders

range.title: Our range
range.orderStrip: No sign-up needed to order: a manager contacts you to confirm.

lead.drinking-yogurt: Drinking yogurts with fruit pieces, and IMMUN+ bio yogurt with vanilla.
lead.thick-yogurt: Thick, spoonable yogurts in 110 g cups.

scan.title: Scan
scan.added: 1 box added to your order list
scan.again: This scan was already counted. Change the number if you need to.
scan.next: Scan the next label with your phone camera.
scan.unknown: This code wasn't recognised. Find the product in the catalog.

paste.title: Paste or dictate an order
paste.hint: Write it the way you would in a chat, or paste a message you received. We recognise each line.
paste.label: Order text
paste.placeholder:
For example:
Kefir 1% 900 — 5 boxes
Qatiq 10
Cocoa sirok 120 pcs
paste.voice: On a phone, tap the microphone on the keyboard and say the order.
paste.unknown: Not recognised. Try writing it differently.
paste.vague: Too many products fit: add the flavour or type.
paste.unsure: “{words}” isn’t in our catalog. Is it this one?
